claims.evidence: Subjective durability claim; no stress test or close-up of wall thickness/cage integrity shown.
No manufacturer label, food-grade stamp, or certification visible in photo 0.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Prior contents and usage history not shown; witness explicitly notes condition/previous contents not visible.
Plastic condition (cracks, discoloration) not shown per witness notes; no close-up of tank walls or base.
Black screw cap is visible on top, but valve/outlet at base not shown, so 'complete' cannot be fully confirmed.

risks.proof: Photo of capacity label/stamp on tank or cage, or a tape-measure shot of dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price at smallest common IBC size assumption or treat volume as unverified, pricing conservatively.

risks.risk: Chemical residue or non-food-grade prior use despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Close-up of original content label/sticker still on tank, or video of interior rinse showing no residue/odor.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-food-grade/contaminated risk until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Cage rust or structural weakness (other totes in background show rust-stained cages)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the specific tote's cage joints, welds, and base frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as corroded/compromised cage until proven solid.

risks.proof: Photo of underside/pallet showing material and structural condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged/unstable pallet until proven intact.

risks.proof: Photo or short video of the base valve being opened and closed with liquid flow.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-functional/missing valve until proven working.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or leaks not visible in a single static photo
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all tank walls/corners, plus a video of a water-fill/leak test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking/cracked until proven sound.

risks.risk: Unknown age/wear of tote affecting plastic brittleness
risks.proof: Photo of manufacture date stamp usually molded on the tank shoulder.
risks.if_unproven: Price as old/unknown-age stock until date is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of capacity label or manufacture date stamp on the tank
Close-up photos of cage welds, corners, and rust spots
Photo/video of base valve opening and water flowing
Video of water-fill test showing no leaks
Close-up of any food-grade or prior-content label on the tank
response.reason: Item type (IBC tote) is confirmed by the witness, but key value-driving claims—capacity, food-grade history, structural soundness, and valve function—are unverified or unverifiable remotely, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
